# Third-party license texts

`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` maps every locked desktop dependency to the license
terms selected for distribution. This directory preserves the corresponding
license texts and package-specific bundled-material notices.

| Identifier / material | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Apache-2.0 | [Apache-2.0.txt](Apache-2.0.txt) |
| BSL-1.0 | [BSL-1.0.txt](BSL-1.0.txt) |
| ISC | [ISC.txt](ISC.txt) |
| MIT | [MIT.txt](MIT.txt) |
| MPL-2.0 | [MPL-2.0.txt](MPL-2.0.txt) |
| OFL-1.1 | [OFL-1.1.txt](OFL-1.1.txt) |
| Ubuntu-font-1.0 | [Ubuntu-font-1.0.txt](Ubuntu-font-1.0.txt) |
| Unicode-3.0 | [Unicode-3.0.txt](Unicode-3.0.txt) |
| Zlib | [Zlib.txt](Zlib.txt) |
| `epaint_default_fonts` bundled fonts | [epaint-default-fonts-notices.txt](epaint-default-fonts-notices.txt) |
| bundled SQLite | [SQLite-public-domain.txt](SQLite-public-domain.txt) |

The shared MIT text is paired with package authors and upstream links in the
generated inventory. Package-specific notices that carry additional copyright,
reserved-name, or public-domain terms are preserved separately here. These
files do not alter the repository's own source-available license.
